segments.en: I am working in construction, I am 35 years old. What about you?
My hometown is Kollam, I am currently in Coimbatore.
I said I am married. You are not married, right?
No, no. Why did you say that?
Nothing, it's just that when girls of your age come, we ask if they are married. I say I am married and have two children. Then what is this app for?
Just to talk, to pass time.
How long have you been using this app?
I have been using it for one year and two months.
Yes, I use it often. I use it for two or three hours daily.
Yes, I use it while I am at work. When I go to the work site, I make calls. People of your age come, good age, 40, 48, 49-year-old ladies have come.
There is nothing like age being high or low.
And in that, there are many clearings, small kids.
They already ask us directly, they call it video call.
Others, if they need financial help, I will give.
A lady came, she is from Bangalore. I have been to Nagercoil for 14 days, I came to my friend's house.
Like that, I talked to her. I talked for a long time. Then she asked me, 'Can you come?' I said, 'I don't even have money for the bus fare.'
I said, 'I can only come by car, I need to fill petrol.'
I said, 'I will give you money for petrol, but you have to stay with me for two days.'
It's a necessity. Some people say they need money.
I said, 'If I give money, is there any point in taking a lady?'
I have not taken any lady after I got married.
Before, I have taken ladies of that age.
35-year-old lady, I was 22 and a half years old then.
Men, men generally like ladies of a higher age. They like to increase friendship.
I didn't hear, it's not time to eat food yet. It's 4:00 PM, I drank tea and ate snacks.
Onam was amazing. How long have you been using this app?
I have been using it for two weeks, two weeks.
Your age, how is this app?
It's okay, it's good. There is no problem.
Then, when they come to you, they ask for open talk, right?
Yes, that is a common thing.
Open talk, I have asked small ladies for open talk.
When they ask me, we talk about open talk, they... they know open talk, open is not known.
Open talk means we already, now usually I ask for open talk, we talk to some ladies, talk openly. Open talk means I mean...
So they, this coming, open talk means they talk about sex. But they don't know sex.
Did you understand? People of your age, then some boys live in Bangalore, they say they have friends, we do sex, we know everything, we can do.
But they, when we talk to them, we know they don't know anything.
A lady told me, 'I will do sex with my friend.' I said, 'Do it.' I said, 'If you are in the mood, do it.'
Then I understood it was a lie. It was just to talk.
They hear from somewhere, we know, they won't do it at that time.
11, 11 days, 9 days, they won't do it. If they do it, you are young, so it will happen quickly.
Did you understand? If they are of age, they know what to do to avoid it.
Did you understand? Is there any problem talking like this?
